title: One card editor with the business half: a Space owner gets their Space card on My card, and their face lists their Spaces
detail: Owner ruling 2026-10-22, "One editor, business extras": a Crew member sees only the Crew version of the card; a member who runs a Space sees the extended business version in either place. /crew/card now mounts, for each Space the member owns (up to 3), the same Space card section the Space's Check in Cards view shows (face editor, cardholder perk, per-card on/off), with a link to the door tools, in place of the old row of Open Check in buttons. The member's public card face (/card/<token>) lists the public, active Spaces they run beside their websites when links are on. 'Use <Space> page' for Open my link already shipped in #3863. Follows LIVE-1282, LIVE-1297 and ADR-1874; no migration.
